## 1. Track 1: Unit, API Integration & State Machine Tests (67 Tests)

Comprehensive pytest test suites were executed across the codebase ([`soulred`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/soulred) and [`tests`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests)):

1. **[test_soulred_prd_comprehensive.py](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/test_soulred_prd_comprehensive.py) (19 Tests)**:
   - **US-001 (Waterfall Feed)**: Adaptive aspect ratio bounding (`1:1`, `3:4`, `4:3`), placeholder tint hashing, multi-channel pagination boundaries, and sub-800ms channel switching latency benchmark.
   - **US-002 (Post Creation & Mood Tags)**: Up to 9 images upload constraints, 1~5 topic tags, mood tags (`治愈中`, `求聊天`, `发呆`), local draft auto-save & recovery, and real-time AI content safety keyword blocking.
   - **US-003 (Matching Engine & Quotas)**: MBTI personality test submission, soul trait vector generation, Soul Radar $\ge 80\%$ filter, bidirectional mutual crush state transition (`pending` $\rightarrow$ `mutual` with automated chat channel establishment), and stranger daily message rate limiting (max 1 text/day, 0 images/voice).
   - **US-004 (IM & Intimacy Level)**: Common hobby extraction for AI icebreaker generation, Soul Intimacy XP progression state machine (`Seed` $\rightarrow$ `Bud` $\rightarrow$ `Flower` $\rightarrow$ `Star`), and strict 2-minute message recall time window.
   - **US-005 (Interest Circles & Comments)**: Category browsing (`艺术展览`, `户外徒步`, `同城交友`, `深夜树洞`), multi-tier threaded comment tree assembly (`L1` $\rightarrow$ `L2` $\rightarrow$ `L3`), and administrative muting moderation.
   - **US-006 (Profile Persona & Privacy Protection)**: 3D avatar & 10-second voice card persona configuration, AES-256-GCM encryption of sensitive credentials, client PII masking (`138****5678`), and granular privacy controls (`hide_distance`, `hide_from_nearby`, `incognito_contacts`).
2. **[test_api_endpoints.py](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/test_api_endpoints.py) (5 Tests)**:
   - User registration, JWT login, profile retrieval/update, feed channels, post creation, like toggle, matching crush flow, and circle comments.
3. **[test_models.py](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/test_models.py) (4 Tests)**:
   - AES-256-GCM symmetric encryption/decryption round-trip integrity, password hashing, and ORM cascading relationships.
4. **[test_services.py](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/test_services.py) (12 Tests)**:
   - Cosine similarity, MBTI golden pair synergy, waterfall aspect ratios, intimacy XP progression, AI safety filters, stranger quotas, and comment tree recursion.
5. **[test_websocket.py](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/test_websocket.py) (2 Tests)**:
   - Real-time bidirectional message exchanges with delivery ACK, ping/pong keepalive, and stranger limits.
6. **[test_portrait_feed.py](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/test_portrait_feed.py) (25 Tests)**:
   - Security payloads (SQLi, XSS, Unicode emojis, regex special chars), filter/sort state machines, like count invariants, pagination slicing, and HTTP 404/405 error boundaries.

---

## 2. Track 2: Browser End-to-End (Playwright) Click Tests (7 Tests)

Executed via headless Chromium with network error interception and UI interaction verification in [test_browser_e2e.py](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/test_browser_e2e.py):

1. **Root Redirection & Interactive Swagger UI (`test_root_portal_redirection_and_swagger_ui_clicks`)**:
   - `GET /` verifies HTTP 307 temporary redirect to `/docs`.
   - Clicks and expands `/health` $\rightarrow$ Clicks `Try it out` $\rightarrow$ Clicks `Execute` $\rightarrow$ Asserts live HTTP 200 response (`"status": "healthy"`).
   - Captured: [`root_portal.png`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/screenshots/root_portal.png) & [`swagger_docs_click.png`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/screenshots/swagger_docs_click.png).
2. **Dual-Column Waterfall Feed (`test_xiaohongshu_waterfall_feed_and_card_components`)**:
   - Verified masonry layout, image cover aspect ratios, creator avatars, and like hearts.
   - Captured: [`xhs_waterfall_feed.png`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/screenshots/xhs_waterfall_feed.png).
3. **Modal Lightbox Lifecycle (`test_portrait_detail_modal_lightbox_lifecycle`)**:
   - Card click opens modal with full-screen image carousel, metadata, and close interaction.
   - Captured: [`xhs_modal_detail.png`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/screenshots/xhs_modal_detail.png).
4. **Category Tag Filtering (`test_tag_filter_and_active_pill_highlight`)**:
   - Category pill clicks, active styling highlight, and content filtering.
   - Captured: [`xhs_search_filter.png`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/screenshots/xhs_search_filter.png).
5. **Like / Unlike State & LocalStorage (`test_like_and_unlike_interaction_and_localstorage_persistence`)**:
   - Optimistic like counter increment (+1), decrement (-1), and cross-reload persistence.
6. **Infinite Scroll & Boundary Footer (`test_infinite_scroll_and_all_caught_up_footer`)**:
   - Viewport scroll sentinel triggering batch loading down to the "All caught up" footer.
   - Captured: [`xhs_infinite_scroll.png`](file:///Users/chz/workspace/auto-agent/workspaces/trust_social_app/tests/screenshots/xhs_infinite_scroll.png).
7. **Search Debounce, Sorting & Empty State (`test_search_and_sort_mechanisms_and_empty_state`)**:
   - Search bar debounce, hot/latest sort toggling, and empty search fallback illustration.
